title: Lecture 3: String Manipulation, Guess and Check, Approximations, Bisection

segments.text: Begin with simple string indexing and slicing examples, asking students to predict each result before the code runs.
Build guess-and-check step by step: choose a guess, test it, update it, and stop when the exact answer is found.
Explain why exact equality can fail for floating-point approximations, then replace it with a tolerance check.
Compare exhaustive guessing with bisection. Ask what information lets bisection discard half of the remaining interval.
Trace the bisection code line by line on a small interval, checking low, high, and the midpoint after every iteration.
Practice on a harder target, give feedback on the stopping condition, and transfer the algorithm to cube roots.
